description: This file contains the implementation of OAuth 1.0 authentication, including classes for OAuth consumers, tokens, signature methods, request handling, data storage, and utility functions. It provides core logic for signing, verifying, and managing OAuth requests and tokens within a PHP project.

classes.name: OAuthException
classes.description: Custom exception class for OAuth-related errors.

classes.name: OAuthConsumer
classes.description: Represents an OAuth consumer with a key, secret, and optional callback URL.

classes.name: OAuthToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth token with key and secret, with serialization methods.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod
classes.description: Abstract base class for OAuth signature methods.

classes.name: OAuthSignatureMethod_RSA_SHA1
classes.description: Implements RSA-SHA1 signing method with abstract key fetch methods.

classes.name: OAuthRequest
classes.description: Handles OAuth request creation, parameter management, signature calculation, and request normalization.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Implements OAuth server functionalities for token fetching and request verification.

classes.name: OAuthDataStore
classes.description: Interface for data storage operations such as token and consumer lookup and creation.

classes.name: OAuthUtil
classes.description: Utility functions for encoding, decoding, parameter parsing, and header processing in OAuth.
